visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a montage of various antique keyboard instruments in a showroom or gallery setting. A young boy wearing glasses and a beige jacket is seen playing a two-manual keyboard instrument, focusing intently on the keys. (2) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black sleeveless top and black skirt, is introduced sitting on a piano bench next to a large, rectangular wooden furniture piece that resembles a polished table. The background features several gold-framed oil paintings and other pianos. (3) The woman begins to open several wooden panels of the 'table,' revealing a set of black and white piano keys and internal strings. Graphical overlays appear showing the evolution from a harpsichord to a square piano. (4) The woman performs a classical piece on the newly opened instrument. The camera provides close-ups of the nameplate on the instrument and a single wooden pedal underneath. (5) In a comedic closing sequence, the woman leans on the closed instrument, and digital stickers of various dishes of food appear on top of it. The video concludes with a branded logo screen featuring a hand playing a modern piano.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a fast-paced, jaunty orchestral piano BGM. A brief background female voice provides an introductory narration. (2) A new phase starts as the primary female speaker enters with a high-pitched, enthusiastic Mandarin greeting. The BGM ducks in volume to allow clear speech. (3) A distinct 'ding' sound effect triggers when graphical captions appear on screen. The host's voice remains energetic and clear. (4) A mechanical wooden click is heard as the instrument lid is opened. The audio texture shifts significantly as the host begins playing a Bach piece on the square piano; the tone is warmer and less resonant than a modern grand piano. (5) The phase transitions back to upbeat pop-inflected piano BGM. The host continues speaking with high vocal arousal. (6) A cartoon-style 'pop' sound effect occurs during the comedic ending, followed by a final rhythmic musical stinger as the logo appears.
